response.original_title: Power Pro Lucha: PowerPro’s Bizarre Adventure
response.overview: “Even in this rotten world, I still want to walk down a path I can believe in!”  Power Pro Lucha leaves the nest and sets off on a Bizarre Adventure to the Lehigh Valley! Join the Live Action Lucha Spectacle as we navigate the fallout from Aniversario weekend, discover how the proverbial deck has been stacked, and see just what else The Power Broker has up his sleeve…
